en: Old sepia-toned postcard divided into two horizontal photographs. The upper photo shows a white masonry church with two tall square towers and a central dome, partly obscured by large trees in a park-like setting. The lower photo shows a wooden church with a high central tower and smaller side tower, surrounded by a low picket fence; the building has tall, narrow windows and a metal roof. Faint handwritten captions in cursive are visible above each photograph, and a vertical note appears along the left margin.
